import json, os, platform, sys, shutil
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import importlib.metadata as metadata
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import psutil
from name_that_llm.io import load_train, sha256_file
from name_that_llm.labels import LABELS
from name_that_llm.analysis import validate_oof
from name_that_llm.metrics import classification_report
from name_that_llm.runtime import environment_snapshot, validate_fold_mapping
from name_that_llm.validation import fold_assignments
root=Path.cwd()
out=root/"reports/p2_20261018_preflight.json"
assert not out.exists(), "Refuse audit overwrite"
audit={"schema_version":1,"audit_id":"p2_20261018_preflight","client_date":"2026-10-18","client_timezone":"Asia/Jakarta","observed_at_utc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"scope":"Read-only P0 artifact, data, fold and CPU environment verification; no training, installs, GPU use or source changes","commands":["PowerShell: OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=2 PYTHONHASHSEED=42; .venv/Scripts/python.exe - (stdin source stored below)"],"blockers":[],"runs":{}}
frames=[]
manifests=[]
for run in ["p0_20261018_run1","p0_20261018_run2"]:
    manifest_path=root/"artifacts"/run/"manifest.json"
    manifest=json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    manifests.append(manifest)
    checks={"manifest_path":str(manifest_path.relative_to(root)),"manifest_sha256":sha256_file(manifest_path),"artifacts":{}}
    for name,artifact in manifest["artifacts"].items():
        p=Path(artifact["path"])
        observed_hash=sha256_file(p)
        observed_bytes=p.stat().st_size
        passed=observed_hash==artifact["sha256"] and observed_bytes==artifact["bytes"]
        checks["artifacts"][name]={"path":str(p.relative_to(root)),"sha256":observed_hash,"bytes":observed_bytes,"matches_p0_manifest":passed}
        if not passed: audit["blockers"].append(run+" artifact mismatch "+name)
    dataset_sha=sha256_file(manifest["dataset_path"])
    checks["dataset_sha256"]=dataset_sha
    checks["dataset_hash_matches"]=dataset_sha==manifest["dataset_sha256"]
    checks["labels_match"]=manifest["labels"]==LABELS
    checks["probability_order_matches"]=manifest["probability_columns"]==["p_"+label for label in LABELS]
    frame=pd.read_csv(manifest["artifacts"]["oof"]["path"],dtype={"id":str,"prompt_id":str})
    validate_oof(frame)
    metric=json.loads(Path(manifest["artifacts"]["metrics"]["path"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    recomputed=classification_report(frame.true_model,frame.pred_model)
    checks["aggregate_metrics_match"]=all(metric[k]==recomputed[k] for k in ["balanced_accuracy","class_recall","class_support","confusion_matrix"])
    checks["balanced_accuracy"]=recomputed["balanced_accuracy"]
    checks["fold_metrics_match"]=True
    for fold in metric["folds"]:
        subset=frame[frame.fold==fold["fold"]]
        measured=classification_report(subset.true_model,subset.pred_model)
        checks["fold_metrics_match"] &= all(fold[k]==measured[k] for k in ["balanced_accuracy","class_recall","confusion_matrix"])
    for key in ["dataset_hash_matches","labels_match","probability_order_matches","aggregate_metrics_match","fold_metrics_match"]:
        if not checks[key]: audit["blockers"].append(run+" "+key)
    frames.append(frame)
    audit["runs"][run]=checks
train=load_train("data/raw/train.csv")
mapping=pd.read_csv("reports/p0_20261018_run1/baseline_fold_assignments.csv",dtype={"id":str,"prompt_id":str})
assigned=validate_fold_mapping(train,mapping,5)
audit["dataset"]={"path":"data/raw/train.csv","sha256":sha256_file("data/raw/train.csv"),"rows":len(train),"prompts":int(train.prompt_id.nunique()),"labels":LABELS,"class_counts":{k:int(v) for k,v in train.model.value_counts().reindex(LABELS).items()},"duplicate_texts":int(train.text.duplicated().sum()),"fold_mapping_sha256":sha256_file("reports/p0_20261018_run1/baseline_fold_assignments.csv"),"same_as_current_groupkfold":bool(np.array_equal(assigned,fold_assignments(train,5))),"folds":[]}
for fold in range(5):
    subset=train[assigned==fold]
    audit["dataset"]["folds"].append({"fold":fold,"validation_rows":len(subset),"validation_prompts":int(subset.prompt_id.nunique()),"validation_label_counts":{k:int(v) for k,v in subset.model.value_counts().reindex(LABELS).items()},"train_prompt_overlap":len(set(subset.prompt_id)&set(train.loc[assigned!=fold,"prompt_id"]))})
for frame in frames:
    aligned=frame.set_index("id").loc[train.id]
    assert np.array_equal(aligned.true_model.to_numpy(),train.model.to_numpy())
    assert np.array_equal(aligned.prompt_id.to_numpy(),train.prompt_id.to_numpy())
    assert np.array_equal(aligned.fold.to_numpy(),assigned)
pcols=["p_"+label for label in LABELS]
audit["p0_repetition"]={"same_predictions":frames[0].pred_model.equals(frames[1].pred_model),"same_metadata":frames[0][["id","prompt_id","fold","true_model"]].equals(frames[1][["id","prompt_id","fold","true_model"]]),"max_probability_absolute_difference":float(np.abs(frames[0][pcols].to_numpy()-frames[1][pcols].to_numpy()).max()),"same_model_sha256":manifests[0]["model_sha256"]==manifests[1]["model_sha256"],"same_fold_sha256":manifests[0]["fold_assignments_sha256"]==manifests[1]["fold_assignments_sha256"]}
env=environment_snapshot()
normalize=lambda name:name.lower().replace("_","-")
current_deps={normalize(k):v for k,v in env["dependencies"].items()}
reference_deps={normalize(k):v for k,v in manifests[0]["environment"]["dependencies"].items()}
lock=Path("reports/p0_20261018_requirements-lock.txt")
lock_deps={}
for line in lock.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig").splitlines():

        name,version=line.split("==",1); lock_deps[normalize(name)]=version
audit["environment"]=env

for key in ["python_match","executable_match","all_dependencies_match_p0","all_pinned_lock_dependencies_match","thread_environment_match","threadpools_match","cpu_match","ram_capacity_match"]:
    if not audit["environment_comparison"][key]: audit["blockers"].append("environment "+key)
